thread:
Alex: Quick post-cutoff check — freeze hit at 23:00. If anyone needs a cherrypick into release/v1.4, call it out here. Also we need someone to pin artifacts and create the annotated tag + draft GH release once uploads are in. I can do the tagging if uploads are ready.

Priya: I have a small metrics fix that needs cherrypick. Will open a PR against release/v1.4 in ~15m.

Tom: I can handle artifact uploads. Which S3 path + checksum style do you want? sha256?

Alex: Use sha256 and put a manifest.json next to artifacts. Path: s3://redwood-release/rcs/v1.4.2/ . Manifest keys: name, sha256, arch. Example manifest snippet: ```{
  "artifact": "runtime.tar.gz",
  "arch": "x86_64",
  "sha256": "...."
}``` Keep filenames deterministic (runtime-v1.4.2-x86_64.tar.gz).

Maya: For the annotated tag, follow pattern `v1.4.2-rc1`. Tag body should list PRs, notable changes, and a quick verifications checklist. I'm pasting a short template: ```v1.4.2-rc1

Changelist:
- PR #123: fix metrics bucket
- PR #126: backfill schema

Verification:
- integ tests: green
- perf smoke: within SLO

Artifacts: s3://redwood-release/rcs/v1.4.2/
```

Alex: And commands we use for the tag/release step (copy/paste): ```git tag -a v1.4.2-rc1 -m "v1.4.2-rc1: release candidate

See changelist in body" && git push origin v1.4.2-rc1
# then create draft release (local notes file)
gh release create v1.4.2-rc1 --draft --title "v1.4.2-rc1" --notes-file release_notes.md```

release-bot: CI: artifacts-build (job/234) passed — :white_check_mark: artifacts ready for upload.

Jorge: I can do the final tag+draft once uploads finish and checksums verified. Ping me when s3 manifest is uploaded and sha256 values posted. I'll also sign the annotated tag (we have the GPG key on the buildbox).

Tom: Uploads done. Manifest and checksums in s3, example checksum: `e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb924...` Link: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-release/rcs/v1.4.2/manifest.json (internal link).

Jorge: Taking tagging step now. Running: ```git tag -a v1.4.2-rc1 -m "v1.4.2-rc1: release candidate

Changelist: PRs 123,126,130
Artifacts: s3://redwood-release/rcs/v1.4.2/" && git push origin v1.4.2-rc1 && gh release create v1.4.2-rc1 --draft --title "v1.4.2-rc1" --notes-file release_notes.md```

Maya: When you create the draft, add both x86_64 and arm64 assets and attach manifest.json as an asset. Also include a short fallback plan in the notes: if the RC fails verification, we revert tag and upload patched RC with -rc2.

Alex: Quick ops reminder: record who pushed the annotated tag and the commit it points to in the release board. If we need rollback, open a rollback PR that reverts the merge commit and call out the release tag in the PR body.

Jorge: Tag pushed and draft created, release notes attached, manifest uploaded as asset. Tag signed with buildbox key. @release-team please review notes + assets. :party_parrot:

Priya: Reviewed notes, LGTM. I'll hold merges to main until QA signs off on this RC.

Tom: Confirming checksums match on the upload side. All good.

Alex: Thanks all. If QA finds issues we'll follow Maya's -rc2 plan. Otherwise we schedule final publish window next week.
